contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IM[P C .....]VS P F AVG

Heavily worn silver washed radiate of uncertain emperor - possibly Victorinus - uncertain reverse - possibly salus feeding snake rising from Altar. Reece Period: 13-14. Obverse description: Bust of a male figure, radiate, right. Obverse inscription: IM[P C .....]VS P F AVG. Reverse description: Unknown - possibly Salus standing left feeding snake rising from altar. Reverse inscription: Die axis…
